title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. demissa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. demissa, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating menstrual disorders, wounds, and skin irritations, as well as having anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. demissa include astringent, hemostatic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a useful treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tannins, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
